thread: The survivor girl and the dispatch ride north; the southbound party is stripped to four

evidence.clue: A child found alive in a bolted cellar: the only living person in Millhaven. She gave fragments to Neral: sickness order, sweet breath, the glass held to her mam's mouth, her mam rising, her da's order, the feet.

Sylvanas's dispatch to Lor'themar: oiled paper, red wax, her ring (blurred), written with the mage's Kirin Tor ink and pen (violet at the rim) after her lead stub failed; text names Millhaven dead, sixty-plus walked out north-northeast, double wardens, the Pass road south is clear, a human child witness comes with the courier, 'I am going on south.'

Neral takes the dispatch tube (strapped to the off side of the bay behind her leg), the girl (in front of her), the fourth ranger and the spare grey; told 'Don't stop at the Pass longer than it takes to change saddles. Put it in Lor'themar's hand yourself.' She changes at the Pass 'and keeps going'.
Sylvanas: the border will be warned 'by tomorrow night, with Neral changing saddles at the Pass'; Convocation would have it by the end of the week.

Chapter 4: Jaina recalls the girl's words (everybody coughing at the well; Missus Hale's baby first, then Mister Pell; sixty sets of toes pointing uphill; sweet breath before fever; 'cheaper than Mister Hollis'); she half turns to tell Neral and finds nobody behind her ('two empty places at the back'). Sylvanas quotes the girl to Brask. No news of Neral, the girl or the dispatch's arrival.

readerKnows: The dispatch and the child are on the road north; the southbound party is Sylvanas, Jaina, Cyndia and Lyriel.
povCharacterKnows: Sylvanas hopes the border is warned but does not know that it will be; she does not know what the Pass will do with a human child.
notes: Neral, the fourth ranger and the girl leave the book's southbound party. The girl never continues south. Arrival at the Pass is not shown in the south thread.
